final:
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([5], 3) == [5]
  var out: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    out.append(x)
  let n = out.len()
  var state = seed % 2147483648
  for k in range(1, n)
    let i = n - k
    state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    let a = out[i]
    let b = out[j]
    out[i] = b
    out[j] = a
  out
